STAFF_EXISTS.label: Already Have Receptionist / Front Desk
STAFF_EXISTS.rootCause: Contractor assumes Ava replaces daytime staff. Failed to emphasize after-hours (5 PM to 8 AM) and weekends.
STAFF_EXISTS.adaptiveAdjustment: Shift focus to Website Design or Speed-to-Lead, and clarify: 'Ava only covers the 128 hours/week when your office is closed.'
STAFF_EXISTS.rebuttalTemplate: Totally understand you have front desk coverage, [Owner]! Ava actually doesn't replace them--she covers the other 128 hours a week when your office is closed (nights, weekends, and lunchtime overflow). Plus our websites and LeadFlow work alongside your front desk to route leads straight to them. Let's do a quick 10-minute Zoom this Tuesday so I can show you how they work together seamlessly.

PRICE_SENSITIVITY.label: Cost / Budget Constraint
PRICE_SENSITIVITY.rootCause: Contractor perceives monthly service as overhead instead of comparing it to saving 1 single high-ticket job.
PRICE_SENSITIVITY.adaptiveAdjustment: Pre-framing ROI: '1 saved emergency job pays for over 2 years of the service.'
PRICE_SENSITIVITY.rebuttalTemplate: Hear you completely on expenses, [Owner]. In your trade, 1 single high-ticket job pays for 2+ years of the system. Let's jump on a quick 10-minute Zoom where I can show you the exact numbers and where your competitors are picking up leads you're currently missing.

AI_SKEPTICISM.label: Skeptical of Robotic Voice AI
AI_SKEPTICISM.rootCause: Bad experiences with outdated IVR phone trees ('Press 1 for Sales').
AI_SKEPTICISM.adaptiveAdjustment: Emphasize human-grade latency and pivot to website design or SMS Speed-to-Lead if they prefer non-voice automation.
AI_SKEPTICISM.rebuttalTemplate: I completely agree with you--clunky robotic menus drive customers away. Ava is conversational voice AI with sub-second latency that speaks naturally. Call her live right now at (561) 813-8602, or let's hop on a 10-minute Zoom so I can show you our automated website and SMS booking systems instead.

BAD_TIMING.label: Too Busy Right Now
BAD_TIMING.rootCause: Contractor is slammed in the field and fears a complicated software onboarding.
BAD_TIMING.adaptiveAdjustment: Emphasize 100% done-for-you setup with zero software configuration required from the contractor.
BAD_TIMING.rebuttalTemplate: Understood, [Owner]--we know you're slammed with field jobs right now. That's exactly why we do 100% of the build and management for you (zero software for you to learn). Let's hop on a brief 10-minute Zoom next week when you have a breather so you can see how it runs hands-free.

winCatalog.label: 15-Minute Zoom Screen Share Walkthrough
winCatalog.winningInsight: Offering a quick 10-15 minute screen share with 2 exact proposed times significantly reduced friction compared to generic 'let's chat' requests.
winCatalog.actionTaken: Made 15-minute Zoom call booking the primary CTA across all outbound templates.

winCatalog.label: Targeted Service Pain Alignment
winCatalog.winningInsight: Matching the email to the contractor's specific weakness (website mobile drop-off vs after-hours call drop vs slow quote response) tripled engagement.
winCatalog.actionTaken: Expanded outbound engine into 5 distinct specialized service angles.

winCatalog.label: 48-Hour Unopened Subject Mutation
winCatalog.winningInsight: Penalizing fatigued subject lines after 48h with zero opens and rotating to high-curiosity operational hooks prevented spam fatigue.
